audience.text: Java developers building applications that require reading, writing, and editing Excel .xlsx workbooks without runtime third-party dependencies.

capabilities.text: The library supports creating new workbooks, loading existing .xlsx files, and saving modified workbooks using Workbook and Worksheet APIs.
capabilities.title: Read and write Excel workbooks

capabilities.text: Developers can set font properties, number formats, borders, alignment, and fill for individual cells via the Style API.
capabilities.title: Cell styling and formatting

capabilities.text: The library supports adding data validation rules and conditional formatting to worksheet ranges using Validation and ConditionalFormatting collections.
capabilities.title: Data validation and conditional formatting

capabilities.text: Developers can create 18 of 25 chart types programmatically and embed images; other chart types round-trip from loaded files.
capabilities.title: Work with charts and shapes

capabilities.text: The library supports configuring page setup, freezing panes, and applying worksheet and workbook protection via dedicated APIs.
capabilities.title: Page setup and print layout

capabilities.text: LoadOptions enables strict mode toggles and repair features; diagnostics report issues encountered during load.
capabilities.title: Repair malformed workbooks

limitations.text: Saving is currently limited to .xlsx format only.
ChartEx types (Waterfall, Treemap, Sunburst, Histogram, Box and Whisker, Funnel, Map) cannot be created programmatically.
Formulas are stored and round-tripped but the library is not a full spreadsheet calculation engine.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic Excel workbook manipulation in Java without requiring Apache POI at runtime, using a pure Java implementation.
Provides robust workbook loading with repair options and diagnostics for corrupted or malformed XLSX files.
Supports data validation, conditional formatting, and styling features for generating formatted reports and dashboards.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Cells FOSS for Java is a free, open-source Java library for creating, loading, modifying, and saving Excel .xlsx workbooks, targeting Java 17 with no runtime dependencies.

uncertainties: The exact set of unimplemented XML-mapper classes and their impact on real-world usage is not fully detailed.
Whether ListObjects support all Excel table features beyond creation, resizing, and styling is unclear.
The behavior of outline grouping for rows/columns beyond basic visibility control is not specified.
How hyperlinks and defined names are serialized in the output .xlsx is not explicitly documented.
The scope of supported picture formats beyond JPEG, PNG, GIF, and BMP is not clarified.
Whether all 38 AutoShapeType geometries support full property customization is not specified.
The exact behavior of workbook-level protection with multiple passwords is not detailed.
Whether conditional formatting rules apply to merged cells is not confirmed.

workflows.name: Build and test
workflows.text: Developers build the project with 'mvn package' and run tests with 'mvn test' using JUnit Jupiter.

workflows.name: Create and save workbook
workflows.text: Developers instantiate a Workbook, add worksheets, write cell values, apply styles, and save to .xlsx using the public API.

workflows.name: Load and repair workbook
workflows.text: Developers load existing workbooks with LoadOptions to enable strict mode toggles and repair features, then inspect diagnostics.

workflows.name: Apply validation and formatting
workflows.text: Developers add data validation and conditional formatting rules to worksheet ranges using CellArea and related collections.
